notes: Created a 7-phase implementation plan addressing all issues from the final pre-merge review (Barbara, 12 parallel subagents). Phase 1 (P0) fixes CR-1: undo/redo completely broken by wiring base.undoManager via getter/setter pattern. Phases 2-3 (P1) fix CropInteraction pointer capture and createImagePanelHandlers callback pattern. Phases 4-5 (P1) add user-facing feedback for image load failures and storage full scenarios. Phase 6 (P1) increases touch targets to WCAG 44x44px minimum. Phase 7 (P1) removes deprecated removeImage(). Each phase includes behavior scenarios at user/component/pure-function levels, test scenarios, and success criteria. Medium-priority issues (M-1 through M-12) and nits (N-1 through N-34) are explicitly deferred to follow-up work.
